title: TSA: Enhanced Screening Decision

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: Operations, this is TSA Supervisor Elena calling from the main terminal checkpoint. We're getting internal reports that NCIA has received a threat. We need to know — should we elevate screening to enhanced level? We can begin in 15 minutes, but it will cause 45-minute wait times for all passengers at the SSCP.

transcript.speaker: OPS
transcript.text: Understood, Agent Elena. We're currently assessing a cyber threat to the AODB system. We have no evidence of a physical device or active threat to the terminal. We're prioritizing digital containment.

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: We're not asking for a threat assessment — we're asking for a decision. Do we proceed with enhanced screening? Your call.

voiceStyles.TSA: Woman in her 40s, stressed, loud checkpoint noise behind her
voiceStyles.OPS: Male, calm, measured, background radio chatter

instructorNote: This inject tests the decision to escalate physical screening in the absence of physical threat evidence. Watch for whether ops chooses operational risk over perceived security, and whether they justify the trade-off.
